features.title: Elemental magic
features.text: Use magical impulses instead of spell slots. Your chosen elements and feats can specialize in area damage, healing, protection or movement; you cannot excel at everything at once.

features.title: A repeating toolkit
features.text: Impulses are repeatable, subject to their own limits. Manage your aura and stances, and reopen the aura after an overflow impulse. Elemental Blast is one option among many.
